paragraphs.text: Last Sunday, I went to Ocean Park. My dad came with me too. We saw a big blue pool. Many sea animals lived in it.
paragraphs.translation: 上周日，我去了海洋乐园。爸爸也和我一起去了。我们看见一个很大的蓝色水池，里面住着许多海洋动物。

paragraphs.text: First, we watched two dolphins swim. Dolly was smaller than her friend Ben. But Ben could jump higher than Dolly. They were both clever and funny.
paragraphs.translation: 我们先看了两只海豚游泳。多莉比她的朋友本个头小一些，不过本跳得比多莉更高。他们俩都又聪明又好玩。

paragraphs.text: Then we met a little green turtle. He was slower than the small fish. But he was older than all of them. "Come with me," said the turtle.
paragraphs.translation: 后来我们遇到了一只绿色的小海龟。他游得比小鱼慢，却比他们谁都年长。海龟说：“跟我来。”

paragraphs.text: We followed him into a dark cave. Inside, we saw many plastic bags. The water was not clean or bright. The fish looked sad and swam away.
paragraphs.translation: 我们跟着他游进一个黑黑的洞穴。洞里面，我们看到很多塑料袋。那里的水既不干净也不明亮，鱼儿看起来很伤心，都游走了。

paragraphs.text: We picked up the bags together. Then the water looked cleaner and more beautiful. The little fish came back to play.
paragraphs.translation: 我们一起把袋子捡了起来。然后那里的水看起来更干净、更漂亮了，小鱼们又回来玩耍了。

paragraphs.text: I was tired but very happy. The sea is our home too. Let's keep it clean and blue.
paragraphs.translation: 我很累，但非常开心。大海也是我们的家。让我们把它保持得干净又湛蓝吧。
